outcome: Payout webhooks are signed with the v2 settlement provider's key

acceptance_criteria.text: signPayout signs with the v2 key by default, and can still sign v1 payouts with the existing key.

expected_verification.assertion: a v2 payout and a v1 payout both produce a valid signature over the canonical body

acceptance_criteria.text: Signing credentials are read from configuration, not held in the repository.

expected_verification.assertion: no signing key literal appears in the package source; the v2 key is read from the environment like the v1 key

data_impact: None. Signing only; no payout data changes shape.
security_impact: Touches the credential that authenticates outbound settlement webhooks.
